title: Crawl space.
officialText: Where lower combustion air openings connect with crawl spaces, such spaces shall have unobstructed openings to the outdoors at least twice that required for the combustion air openings. The height of the crawl space shall co mply with the requirements of the New York City Building Code and shall be without obstruction to the free flow of air.
